H3 planning units resolutions 6 7. h3_address column supplied H3 planning-unit ID used throughout workflow. build_h3_maps() identifies parent–child relationships among H3 planning units stores hierarchy used multiscale functions. first parent seven children, costing 2 units, complete footprint costs 14. second parent contains two possible resolution-7 children.
code: seed <- "87182e586ffffff"  grandparent <- h3jsr::get_parent(seed, 5L, simple = TRUE)  parents <- h3jsr::get_children(grandparent, 6L, simple = TRUE) parents <- sort(as.character(unlist(parents, use.names = FALSE)))[1:2]  parent_full <- parents[1] parent_partial <- parents[2]  # get the seven children for the first parent. children_full <- h3jsr::get_children(parent_full, 7L, simple = TRUE) children_full <- sort(as.character(unlist(children_full, use.names = FALSE)))  # Only two available children for the second parent. children_partial_all <- h3jsr::get_children(parent_partial, 7L, simple = TRUE) children_partial_all <- sort(as.character(unlist(children_partial_all, use.names = FALSE))) children_partial <- children_partial_all[1:2]  h3_vec <- c(parent_full,children_full,parent_partial,children_partial)  pu <- h3jsr::cell_to_polygon(h3_vec, simple = FALSE) pu <- pu[match(h3_vec, pu$h3_address), ] pu <- sf::st_transform(pu, 3857)  pu$res <- c(6L,rep(7L, length(children_full)),6L,rep(7L, length(children_partial)))  # Synthetic additive costs. pu$cost <- c(14,rep(2, length(children_full)),14,rep(2, length(children_partial)))  maps <- build_h3_maps(pu,res_levels = c(6L, 7L))  knitr::kable(sf::st_drop_geometry(pu)[, c("h3_address", "res", "cost")])

C_a set planning units cover atom , atom activation linked planning-unit selection z_a >= x_i C_a z_a <= sum(x_i, C_a).
